scripts.music: mkdir -p public && ${PYTHON:-python3} scripts/music.py intro public/music.wav && ${PYTHON:-python3} scripts/music.py teaser public/music-25.wav
scripts.render:intro: mkdir -p out && remotion render src/index.ts Intro out/kanban-intro-45s.mp4 --codec h264 --crf 18 --concurrency=1 --gl=swangle && sh scripts/mux.sh intro-45s music
scripts.render:teaser: mkdir -p out && remotion render src/index.ts Teaser out/kanban-teaser-25s.mp4 --codec h264 --crf 18 --concurrency=1 --gl=swangle && sh scripts/mux.sh teaser-25s music-25
scripts.render: npm run music && npm run render:teaser && npm run render:intro
